title: за and под: going behind, under

blocks.text: Prepositions used with the accusative case
Prepositions **в**, **на**, **под** and **за** are followed by the accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion:

items: Я купил книгу за два рубля.

blocks.text: From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 61.

exercises.q: Око за ___ (око, acc. sg.), зуб за зуб.
exercises.prompt: An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth.
exercises.why: **око → око** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -о — declines like DLI's окно: A. окно. Ending -о → -о.  Declension: sg. око · ока · оку · око · оком · оке; pl. очи · очей · очам · очи · очами · очах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
